idempotency.format: 16..128 visible ASCII characters after trim; no whitespace-only value

allocation: read last confirmed and unresolved local reservations
compare approved provider pending and latest nonces
enter reconciliation if provider views disagree or a gap exists
reserve the smallest safe nonce and increment ledger generation
nonceLedger.releaseBeforeSigning: only when no signature exists and reservation generation still matches
nonceLedger.restart: rebuild unresolved set from database then reconcile chain evidence before new allocation
nonceLedger.gapPolicy: stop allocation for that ledger and reconcile; never fill by guessing

stateDefinitions.signed: Signer produced a transaction hash and encrypted raw transaction reference; no provider accepted it yet.
stateDefinitions.broadcast: An approved provider accepted the raw transaction submission or returned the same known transaction hash.
stateDefinitions.pending: The transaction is visible in an approved pending view and has no canonical receipt.
stateDefinitions.confirmed: A canonical success receipt exists and every required nonce, balance, and applicable Token Transfer reconciliation passed.
stateDefinitions.failed: A canonical failure receipt exists or an irreversible pre-broadcast validation/signing failure occurred.
stateDefinitions.dropped: No canonical receipt or approved pending view contains the transaction after the configured evidence window; reconciliation remains required.
stateDefinitions.replaced: A later lineage transaction with the same chainId, walletId, nonce, and immutable plan became the active head.

transitions.condition: provider acceptance with expected tx hash
terminal policy failure before any provider acceptance
approved replacement becomes active before original broadcast
evidence window exhausted with no receipt or pending observation
receipt block becomes non-canonical during reorg; operation re-enters reconciliation
failed receipt block becomes non-canonical during reorg
same transaction is observed again before nonce is consumed
historical transaction, not claimed active head, obtains canonical receipt and lineage is reconciled

replacement.activeHead: highest approved non-terminal generation, never inferred from fee alone

broadcast.alreadyKnown: accept only when returned or derived hash equals stored signed hash
broadcast.ambiguousTimeout: query by transaction hash and reconcile before any resubmission

nativeTransfer.senderDelta: value plus actual gas cost within explicitly accounted external inflows
nativeTransfer.recipientDelta: value within explicitly accounted external flows

erc20Transfer.senderTokenDelta: amount adjusted only for documented fee-on-transfer policy; unsupported tokens fail preview
erc20Transfer.tokenTransferLogs: at least one canonical matching Transfer event with exact contract, sender, recipient, and amount

confirmation.reorg: remove success projection and replay reconciliation from canonical evidence

beforePreview: base-unit amount positive and within balance
security password branch for new external address
beforeSigning: fee caps and current balance sufficiency
